questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle warns that it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, construction vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. The triangle is solid orange during the day and appears as a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions ahead. This sign warns that traffic signals are coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line over a black symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let traffic and pedestrians crossing your path go first. Stop if needed before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing downward is always a yield sign. You must be ready to slow down or stop when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on roadways. You must come to a complete stop at this sign. Do not proceed until it is clear and safe to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings or symbols. They inform drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests and use paddles or red flags to direct traffic through construction zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs, cones, and barrels indicate work zones. This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Follow all directions the flagger gives you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop. Look in all directions for traffic before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign means the road ahead is divided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean you are near a school. Stay alert and be ready to stop for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Be ready for merging traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to areas where pedestrians, animals, or cyclists may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a side road is intersecting ahead. Stay alert.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign indicates you are near a school. Be ready to stop if you see children in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that travel slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is a traffic law. It means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming conditions. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid losing control and to prevent brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and prepare to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming conditions. This sign warns you to be careful when it rains because the road becomes slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians pass before you proceed. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look both ways and listen for trains. Be ready to stop if a train is coming. Never try to drive faster than an approaching train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow pennant-shaped sign marks a no passing zone.
